author: hasl
body:
Hey all,

I came across this old, but nifty site where there's an array of games you can test yourself on!
http://www.humanbenchmark.com/

What are your highscores?

Mine:
  • Number memory: 9 digits
  • Reaction time: 200ms
  • Verbal memory: 21 points
  • Visual memory: 13,584 points

Have a go yourself and leave your scores below!
